items.author: midnightcoffee.bsky.social
items.context: All I have left to do today is play video games for fun, why is my brain trying to turn that into labor? Shut up, we're relaxing! For fun! There's no more boxes to check or tasks to complete!!
items.text: Very relatable. Games without a quest list or timers can help your brain remember it's play. Hope tonight is pure fun.
